summary: Shows one of two text versions depending on the site's mode, with a short fade when the mode changes.
purpose: Lets a single piece of text switch between calm and nerd wording.
why: Saves each caller from writing its own mode check.
how: Reads the mode, shows the calm text or the nerd text, and gives the element a changing key so the fade replays on each switch.
inputs: A calm text and a nerd text.
outputs: A span containing whichever text matches the current mode.
risks: Both texts are required. Any value other than calm shows the nerd text.
debug: If the wrong text shows, check the current mode and confirm both strings were passed in.
